title: No Fundraising Future
primary_theme: Early-stage founder preparedness and capital scarcity discipline
founder_lessons: Ask what you would do if you could never raise capital again, regardless of how much money you just raised.
Prepare deeply before approaching investors; the internet removes excuses for not learning the process.
Use customer adoption inside a VC portfolio as a high-trust path to investor introductions.
Seek investors who combine signal with direct pattern-based guidance.
notable_quotes: what would you do with your company if you could never raise again?
there's really no excuse for any founder to not be prepared to go interface with an investor.
you can fool investors, but you can't fool customers.
